name: The Power of Truth
source:
He’s brilliant. Respected. Desired. But behind every lecture lies a question that haunts him...

At Infinity College, he’s the vice president and star professor—charismatic, sharp, and effortlessly successful. But no amount of prestige can silence the one truth he can’t escape:

He doesn’t know who he is.

Raised in foster homes. No records. No roots.

Not dead. Just… vanished.

Now, the man who’s taught the best of the best to seek answers embarks on a journey to find his own. A search for identity that will unravel more than he ever expected—leading him through a world of secrets, sex, danger, and deception.

Haunted by flashes of a life he can’t remember and a growing fear that he wasn’t just abandoned… he was designed...

The Power of Truth—When the Past Is a Lie, What Will You Believe?

Unlock the mystery. Rewrite your destiny.
translation:
他很聪明。受人尊敬。想要的。但每次讲座的背后都有一个困扰他的问题……

他是无限学院的副校长和明星教授——魅力非凡、敏锐且毫不费力就能取得成功。但再多的声望也无法掩盖他无法逃避的一个事实：

他不知道自己是谁。

在寄养家庭长大。没有记录。无根。

没死。只是……消失了。

现在，这位教导最优秀的人寻找答案的人踏上了寻找答案的旅程。对身份的探索将超出他的预期——带领他穿越一个充满秘密、性、危险和欺骗的世界。

被他不记得的生活的闪现所困扰，并且越来越担心他不仅仅是被遗弃的……他是被设计的……

真理的力量——当过去都是谎言时，你会相信什么？

解开谜底。改写你的命运。
